Standard: Electrical connectors contain redundant, visually verifiable, locking features and keyed interfaces to prevent misalignment and improper installation. Connectors and cables are protected from water intrusion. Cables are routed and affixed to prevent wear and chafing. At cold atmospheric temperatures, the electrical cables maintain flexibility without damage, and the connectors are connected and disconnected using normal maintenance procedures. Separation exists between cables, combustible fluids, and ignition sources to minimize the potential of fire and ignition. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review documentation (e.g., hardware drawings, system configuration descriptions, materials and manufacturing records, design data records, inspection reports, photographs, ICD, or other substantiating records and reports) and verify design of the engine electrical cables and connectors. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Analysis.
  (1) Analysis is conducted to verify design of the engine electrical connectors and cables. Demonstration.
    (1) Demonstrate on the installed engine, the connector’s redundant locking features and keyed interfaces to prevent misalignment and improper installation.
    (2) Demonstrate, on an installed engine, at cold atmospheric temperatures, the electrical cables maintain flexibility without damage, and the connectors are connected and disconnected using normal maintenance procedures.
